Description: Mean and standard deviation of the extracellular spike waveform of each unit, copied from NIX arrays Spike_Waveform_Unit_<unit>_<microwire>.

statistic.Description: Summary statistic across all spikes of the unit

s00.Description: First of 64 waveform samples (columns s00..s63). Sample k is at time -0.00059375 s + k * 3.125e-05 s relative to the detected spike peak (32 kHz microwire sampling).
